name: ESO 496-G010 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 496-G010, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso496g010-hubble
story: One of the nearby galaxies Hubble visited to map our cosmic neighborhood in three dimensions. Astronomers gauge its distance from the brightness of its brightest red giant stars.

claims.text: ESO 496-G010 is a target of Hubble program 13442, which measures distances to nearby galaxies
The distances allow 3D maps of galaxy distributions
